question: Let $f(x)=(x^2+18)(x-4)x(x+4)-2$. Then
solution:
$f'(x)=5x^4+6x^2-288$ has two real roots, so $f$ can have at most three real roots. Also
\[
f(-4)<0,\,f(-3)>0,\,f(0)<0,\,f(4)<0,\,f(5)>0.
\]
Hence there are three real roots, so option (B).
